claim: Hatchet executes multi-step workflows as directed acyclic graphs where step results are streamed over gRPC, and overall workflow status commits are strictly authored by the orchestrator task.
mechanism: Dispatcher coordinates step runs across workers. In operator DAGs, child tasks report step-level completions, but only the orchestrator evaluates final status and triggers downstream steps.
applicabilityConditions: All Hatchet workflow and operator DAG executions
localContext: Dispatcher coordinates step runs across workers. In operator DAGs, child tasks report step-level completions, but only the orchestrator evaluates final status and triggers downstream steps. Known limits: DAG steps must return JSON-serializable outputs for downstream data passing.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Dispatcher coordinates gRPC connections to worker agents, registers active worker pools, and handles graceful worker disconnections.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that operator DAG status transitions originate solely from orchestrator events rather than child tasks.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Restricted DAG status authority strictly to the orchestrator task and serialized updates via ordering constraints.

claim: Hatchet manages worker execution capacity in server memory as slot pools, matching task action constraints against worker labels and rotating among equal-affinity workers to prevent hotspot starvation.
mechanism: Scheduler maintains in-memory slot pools by worker ID, ranks workers by label match scores, and rotates round-robin offsets on ties before pushing tasks over gRPC streams.
applicabilityConditions: All task and step scheduling in pkg/scheduling/v1
localContext: Scheduler maintains in-memory slot pools by worker ID, ranks workers by label match scores, and rotates round-robin offsets on ties before pushing tasks over gRPC streams. Known limits: Slot pool state is maintained in server memory and rebuilt upon dispatcher reconnect.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Scheduler evaluates worker slot availability, matches task action requirements against worker labels, and assigns execution slots.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that scheduler round-robins task assignments across workers having equal label affinity scores.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Rotated the highest-ranked tied worker group to distribute tasks fairly across equal-affinity workers.

claim: Workers maintain persistent bidirectional gRPC streams to the Hatchet server, receiving assigned actions directly into memory buffers without database polling overhead.
mechanism: DispatcherServer handles worker registration streams, streams ActionEvents, accepts TaskAcks, and propagates cancellation signals immediately upon step timeouts.
localContext: DispatcherServer handles worker registration streams, streams ActionEvents, accepts TaskAcks, and propagates cancellation signals immediately upon step timeouts. Known limits: Requires persistent TCP connectivity between worker agents and the Hatchet dispatcher.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Dispatcher coordinates gRPC connections to worker agents, registers active worker pools, and handles graceful worker disconnections.

claim: Workflows can suspend and await external user events (ctx.wait_for_event), matched in PostgreSQL with strict workflow run and step run scope isolation to prevent cross-workflow event delivery.
mechanism: DurableEvents logs events and evaluates matching queries filtered by tenant_id, workflow_run_id, and step_run_id, resuming suspended step runs upon match.
applicabilityConditions: All durable user event listeners and webhook wakeups
localContext: DurableEvents logs events and evaluates matching queries filtered by tenant_id, workflow_run_id, and step_run_id, resuming suspended step runs upon match. Known limits: Event listeners expire if no matching event is published within configured timeout window.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Ticker runs periodic tick loops to evaluate cron triggers, check worker lease heartbeats, and evict timed-out step runs.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that durable user event matches are strictly isolated to their target workflow and step run scopes.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Added explicit workflow run and step run scope identifiers to durable event matching queries.

claim: Hatchet enforces group-level and tenant-level concurrency limits with pluggable resolution strategies (CancelInProgress, GroupRoundRobin, CancelNewest), consolidating single-task gates to eliminate double locking.
mechanism: ConcurrencyController tracks active runs per concurrency key; Strategy preempts lowest-priority running tasks or queues incoming tasks according to policy.
localContext: ConcurrencyController tracks active runs per concurrency key; Strategy preempts lowest-priority running tasks or queues incoming tasks according to policy. Known limits: CancelInProgress requires tasks to handle graceful cancellation signals.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Concurrency manages slot counts per concurrency group, evaluating whether new workflow runs can execute immediately or must queue.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that single-task workflow concurrency configuration merges directly onto the task definition.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Merged workflow-level concurrency limits directly onto the task definition for single-task workflows.

claim: Child workflows and DAG steps use deterministic namespaced keys to guarantee idempotent re-execution while preventing collision between internal step runs and user-spawned workflows.
mechanism: Ids module generates child spawn keys incorporating parent workflow ID, step index, and spawn namespace prefix, preventing duplicate suppression across distinct steps.
applicabilityConditions: Child workflow spawns and DAG step re-runs
localContext: Ids module generates child spawn keys incorporating parent workflow ID, step index, and spawn namespace prefix, preventing duplicate suppression across distinct steps. Known limits: Spawn keys must remain deterministic across replay passes.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that child spawn key generator namespaces DAG step child workflows distinctly from user child spawns.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Namespaced child spawn keys using distinct prefixes for internal DAG steps versus user-spawned workflows.

claim: The Ticker daemon evaluates cron triggers and monitors worker lease heartbeats, evicting dead workers and rescheduling orphaned step runs.
mechanism: Ticker evaluates cron expressions via cron parser, inserts scheduled workflow triggers into PostgreSQL, and queries expired worker leases to initiate task reassignment.
applicabilityConditions: Cron workflows and worker liveness tracking
localContext: Ticker evaluates cron expressions via cron parser, inserts scheduled workflow triggers into PostgreSQL, and queries expired worker leases to initiate task reassignment. Known limits: Leader election via PostgreSQL advisory locks ensures only one active ticker evaluates crons at a time.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Ticker runs periodic tick loops to evaluate cron triggers, check worker lease heartbeats, and evict timed-out step runs.

claim: Worker SDKs execute step functions inside wrapped context objects that continuously send heartbeat pings to the dispatcher over the gRPC control stream.
mechanism: Worker context launches a background goroutine sending Heartbeat messages every N seconds, extending task lease in LeaseManager until step completion.
applicabilityConditions: All worker action executions in Go, Python, and TypeScript SDKs
localContext: Worker context launches a background goroutine sending Heartbeat messages every N seconds, extending task lease in LeaseManager until step completion. Known limits: If worker process hangs completely without yielding to Go runtime, heartbeat ping stops and task times out.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: LeaseManager tracks active worker leases, validating incoming heartbeat pings and marking expired worker nodes as unhealthy.

claim: Tenants possess isolated rate limits and queue fences, preventing single-tenant execution bursts from consuming global worker fleet capacity.
mechanism: Scheduler evaluates tenant rate limit buckets before assigning slots, deferring task dispatches when tenant token buckets are depleted.
localContext: Scheduler evaluates tenant rate limit buckets before assigning slots, deferring task dispatches when tenant token buckets are depleted. Known limits: Rate limits apply per tenant or per action type.
